honest_finding: Label-only lookup reaches QWK=0.838 using zero pixels -- a strong shortcut ceiling. Under frozen features, P1 (leaky split, QWK=0.536) does NOT outperform P2 (honest split, QWK=0.559); the difference is -0.022 and not significant (paired permutation p=0.125). The partner-eye ablation on P1 test images shows a +0.051 QWK gap (present vs absent, multinomial) that is also not significant (p=0.185; ordinal gap +0.061, p=0.0505). Together: with frozen (non-fine-tuned) features, patient-level leakage does not measurably inflate scores. This does not rule out leakage under fine-tuning (Phase 6), where a model can memorize image-specific detail -- that open question is left for later phases, not answered by this figure.
